role: infinitary language with set-size conjunctions and finite quantifier strings
notes: Marker's notation; formulas may have infinitely many free variables, sentences coincide with those of def:p02-lomega-one-omega.

role: infinitary language with conjunctions of size below kappa
notes: kappa an infinite cardinal; L_{omega_1,omega} is the countable case.

role: agreement on all L_{infty,omega}-sentences
notes: Pointed form used in annex:p03-w03-p03-039-karp.

role: formal negation of a formula
notes: Syntactic operation pushing negation inward; distinct from the relation symbol sim_alpha.

role: A-elementary substructure relation for a fragment A
notes: Also equiv_A for agreement on sentences of A.

role: existence of a partial isomorphism system
notes: Karp's notation as used by Marker.

role: infinite back-and-forth game between two structures
notes: Player II wins if the map built is a partial embedding.

role: ordinal-indexed back-and-forth relation on pointed structures
notes: Coincides with equiv_alpha of def:p03-morley-approximants (proved bridge in sec:p03-w03-p03-039-bridge).

role: quantifier rank of an L_{infty,omega}-formula
notes: Ordinal valued; supremum at conjunctions and disjunctions.

role: agreement on sentences of quantifier rank at most alpha
notes: Local to this section; def:p03-morley-approximants uses the same glyph for the pointed back-and-forth relation.

role: Scott formula of a tuple at stage alpha
notes: Marker's notation; compare theta^alpha_a of def:p03-morley-scott-formulas.

role: Scott sentence of an infinite structure
notes: Built at the Scott rank; lies in L_{kappa^+,omega}.

role: Scott rank of a structure
notes: Least alpha with Gamma_alpha = Gamma_{alpha+1}.

role: rank of a tuple in a structure
notes: Also SR(M) = sup of r(a)+1.

role: set of sim_alpha-equivalent tuple pairs within one structure
notes: Local to the Scott-rank lemma; not the type set Gamma of thm:p03-w03-p03-039-chang.

role: consistency property
notes: Collection of countable sets of L_{omega_1,omega}-sentences satisfying C0-C7.

role: Nadel's infinitary logic with set conjunctions and single-variable quantifiers
notes: Nadel's notation; same sentences as \(\mathcal L_{\infty,\omega}\) of def:p03-w03-p03-039-language.

role: Nadel's sublogic with conjunctions of size below a regular kappa
notes: Only regular kappa; singular case not defined in the source.

role: infinitary logic with quantification over fewer than lambda variables
notes: Includes \(\mathscr L_{\infty\infty}\) and \(\mathscr L_{\omega_1\omega_1}\).

role: kappa-partial isomorphism via a nonempty kappa-back and forth set
notes: \(\cong_p\) is \(\cong_{p,\omega}\); coincides with \(\cong_p\) of def:p03-w03-p03-039-partial-iso (thm:p03-w03-p03-039-nadel-bridge).

role: fragment of \(\mathscr L_{\infty\omega}(\tau)\) in Nadel's sense; also \(L_B\) for a transitive set B
notes: For transitive B, \(L_B = \mathscr L_{\infty\omega} \cap B\).

role: L_{infty omega} sentence characterizing the ordinal alpha
notes: Built from the formulas \(\varphi_\beta(x)\) of the same theorem.

role: Kripke-Platek set theory without urelements
notes: Nadel's pure version; distinct from KPU.

role: class of bounded-quantifier formulas of set theory
notes: Also \(\Sigma_1\) and \(\Sigma\) formula classes.

role: transitive closure of a set
sets of hereditary cardinality below kappa
notes: HF = H(aleph_0), HC = H(aleph_1).

role: least ordinal not in a transitive set B
ultraproduct of structures by an ultrafilter
notes: [f] is the class of f; sigma-complete U gives Los for L_{omega_1,omega}.

role: L_{omega_1 omega} sentence whose models are the orders isomorphic to (Z,<)
notes: Defined in annex:p03-w03-p03-039-axiomatizable item iv; reused in def:p03-w03-p03-039-categorical-incomplete.

role: L_{omega_1 omega} sentence whose models are the orders isomorphic to (Z,<)
notes: The same sentence as in annex:p03-w03-p03-039-axiomatizable item iv, reused in the body example.

role: class of tau-structures (PC classes; Silver's class)
notes: Marker's notation; local to def:p03-w03-p03-039-pc and thm:p03-w03-p03-039-silver.

role: beth cardinals: beth_0 = aleph_0; beth_{a+1} = 2^{beth_a}; sup at limits
notes: Strong limits are beth_0 and beth_delta for limit delta.

role: L_{omega_1 omega} formula defining sim_beta on n-tuples
notes: Marker's notation (Ex. 2.21); countable tau.

role: L_{omega_1 omega} sentence true exactly when SR(M) >= alpha
notes: Marker's notation (Ex. 2.21(b)); distinct from Nadel's sigma_alpha of thm:p03-w03-p03-039-nadel-ordinals (separate scopes).

role: L_{omega_1 omega} sentence characterizing a finite structure up to isomorphism
notes: Countable tau.

role: set of countable subsets of a set X
notes: Marker's notation (Sec. 2.3); countable includes finite.

role: filter of families of countable subsets of X that include a club
notes: Kueker/Jech club filter as in Marker (p. 23); a.e. means membership in D(X).

role: diagonal intersection of families indexed by I subset of X
notes: Marker's notation (Lemma 2.38).

role: approximation of an infinitary formula by a countable set a
notes: Depends on the indexing of conjunctions and disjunctions; Marker Def. 2.41.

role: substructure of M with universe M cap a
notes: Defined when M cap a is the universe of a substructure; Marker p. 24.

role: negation normal form of a formula
notes: Built from the formal negation sim with the same index sets.

role: A-type of a tuple in M
notes: Marker Def. 2.33; A a fragment of L_{omega_1,omega}.

role: set of A-types of n-tuples realized in models of a sentence
notes: Marker Def. 2.33; the notes print T for the sentence phi.
